title: Compensation
summary: Turn a hard sum into an easy one: round a number to the nearest ten, work it out, then fix the answer. $38 + 27 = 40 + 27 - 2$. Use it for adding and taking away $9$, $19$ and numbers near a ten.
bigIdeas: Round a number to a friendly ten, calculate, then fix what you changed.
If you added too much, take it away; if you took away too much, add it back.
tips: Add $9$ by adding $10$, then taking $1$ away: $46 + 9 = 56 - 1 = 55$.
Add $19$ by adding $20$, then taking $1$ away: $34 + 19 = 54 - 1 = 53$.
Take away $9$ by taking away $10$, then adding $1$ back: $53 - 9 = 43 + 1 = 44$.
Move both numbers the same way and the difference stays the same: $62 - 38 = 64 - 40 = 24$.
